words.enDefinition: an agreement to rent a home for personal use

examples.en: Our residential lease starts a week before classes, which gives us time to settle in.
examples.zh: 我们的「住宅租约」在开课前一周生效，这样就有时间安顿下来。

examples.en: The housing adviser read my residential lease and marked the sections about overnight visitors.
examples.zh: 住房顾问看了我的「住宅租约」，标出了有关访客留宿的条款。

words.enDefinition: a rental agreement written using a common prescribed form

examples.en: The agent sent us the standard lease so we could read it before signing.
examples.zh: 中介把「标准租约」发给我们，方便我们签字前先看一遍。

examples.en: I compared the standard lease with the one my previous landlord had given me.
examples.zh: 我把「标准租约」和上一位房东给我的那份做了比较。

words.enDefinition: a proposed rental contract that can still be changed

examples.en: My roommate caught an error in our names when she read the draft lease.
examples.zh: 室友看「租约草案」的时候发现我们的名字写错了。

examples.en: Could you send me the draft lease before I commit to taking the room?
examples.zh: 我决定租下这个房间前，你能先把「租约草案」发给我吗？

words.enDefinition: a duplicate document that bears the required signatures

examples.en: I kept a signed copy on my phone so I could check the move-out date.
examples.zh: 我在手机上存了一份「已签字的副本」，方便查搬出日期。

examples.en: The letting agent promised to email a signed copy once the landlord had approved it.
examples.zh: 中介答应房东确认后发来一份「已签字的副本」。

words.enDefinition: the person who leases property from another party

examples.en: The contract lists me as the lessee because I am renting the studio myself.
examples.zh: 合同上我是「承租人」，因为这套开间是我自己租的。

examples.en: Please check that the name of the lessee matches the name on your passport.
examples.zh: 请核对「承租人」的姓名是否和护照上的一致。

words.enDefinition: the party that grants another person a lease

examples.en: I had to look up lessor before I knew which signature was the landlord's.
examples.zh: 我查了一下「出租人」这个词，才知道哪个签名是房东的。

examples.en: The student asked the lessor for permission to repaint the bedroom over the summer.
examples.zh: 学生问「出租人」能否在暑假重新粉刷卧室。

words.enDefinition: someone who rents a property alongside another tenant

examples.en: Each co-tenant received an electronic copy after everyone had signed the same apartment lease.
examples.zh: 所有人签完同一份公寓租约后，每位「共同承租人」都收到了一份电子副本。

examples.en: My co-tenant and I checked the renewal dates together before emailing the management office.
examples.zh: 我和「共同承租人」一起核对了续租日期，然后才给物业办公室发邮件。

words.enDefinition: the only person renting a home under the agreement

examples.en: I was the sole tenant on the lease even though my brother visited often.
examples.zh: 虽然我弟弟经常来，但租约上的「唯一承租人」是我。

examples.en: As the sole tenant of the studio, Maya dealt directly with the landlord about repairs.
examples.zh: 作为这套开间的「唯一承租人」，玛雅有维修问题就直接找房东。

collocations: the sole tenant on the lease

words.enDefinition: a tenant who rents directly and sublets to others

examples.en: I arranged the room with the head tenant, who had signed the main lease.
examples.zh: 我和签了主租约的「主承租人」谈妥了租房间的事。

examples.en: The head tenant introduced me to the landlord before I moved into the shared flat.
examples.zh: 我搬进合租公寓前，「主承租人」把我介绍给了房东。

words.enDefinition: someone identified by name as a renter in a lease

examples.en: As a named tenant, I wanted my own copy of the agreement for my records.
examples.zh: 作为租约上「列名的承租人」，我也想留存一份合同。

examples.en: The agent verified that every named tenant had signed before sending us the final copy.
examples.zh: 中介确认每位「列名承租人」都签字后，才把最终版本发给我们。

collocations: a named tenant on the agreement
the signature of a named tenant

words.enDefinition: someone who takes the place of a departing renter

examples.en: I found a replacement tenant through the student housing group before my semester abroad.
examples.zh: 出国交换前，我通过学生租房群找到了「接替承租人」。

examples.en: The agent asked the replacement tenant to send proof of enrollment before discussing the handover.
examples.zh: 中介让「接替承租人」先发在读证明，再谈交接。

words.enDefinition: someone allowed to live there without being a tenant

examples.en: My sister was listed as an authorized occupant and received her own building key.
examples.zh: 我姐姐被登记为「获准居住者」，拿到了一把自己的楼门钥匙。

examples.en: The manager asked if my partner should be listed as an authorized occupant instead.
examples.zh: 物业经理问要不要改把我的伴侣列为「获准居住者」。

words.enDefinition: the greatest number of people allowed to live somewhere

examples.en: The occupancy limit means our friend cannot move in with us next semester as planned.
examples.zh: 受「居住人数上限」限制，我们的朋友下学期不能按原计划搬来同住。

examples.en: I checked the occupancy limit before asking a third classmate to share the apartment.
examples.zh: 我先确认了「居住人数上限」，才邀请第三位同学来合租。

words.enDefinition: a visitor who stays for an extended period

examples.en: The lease defines a long-term guest as anyone who stays beyond the stated number of nights.
examples.zh: 租约把留宿超过指定晚数的人定义为「长期留宿访客」。

examples.en: I asked whether my cousin would count as a long-term guest during her summer course.
examples.zh: 我问表姐暑期上课期间住在我这里算不算「长期留宿访客」。

collocations: notify management about a long-term guest

words.enDefinition: set hours when residents must keep noise low

examples.en: The landlord explained that quiet hours start earlier on weekdays because many residents study at home.
examples.zh: 房东说工作日的「静音时段」开始得更早，因为很多住户在家学习。

examples.en: We moved our board game night forward so everyone could leave before quiet hours.
examples.zh: 我们把桌游活动提前了，好让大家在「静音时段」前离开。

words.enDefinition: a contract provision forbidding smoking in specified areas

examples.en: The no-smoking clause covers shared hallways as well as the rooms inside our flat.
examples.zh: 「禁烟条款」适用于公共走廊，也适用于我们公寓里的房间。

examples.en: Does the no-smoking clause apply to the outdoor area next to the laundry room?
examples.zh: 洗衣房旁边的室外区域也适用「禁烟条款」吗？

words.enDefinition: a document adding pet conditions to a lease

examples.en: The landlord sent a pet addendum after I asked to bring my indoor cat.
examples.zh: 我问能不能带上我的家养猫后，房东发来了一份「宠物补充协议」。

examples.en: I read the pet addendum to see whether my roommate could adopt a dog.
examples.zh: 我看了「宠物补充协议」，想确认室友能不能领养一只狗。

words.enDefinition: an activity that a property agreement does not allow

examples.en: The lease lists running a shop from the apartment as a prohibited use of the unit.
examples.zh: 租约把在公寓里开店列为房屋的「禁止用途」。

examples.en: Before starting her tutoring service here, Lena checked what the agreement calls a prohibited use.
examples.zh: 在这里做辅导之前，莉娜先看了合同列出的「禁止用途」。

words.enDefinition: a restriction limiting a property to use as a home

examples.en: The lease says residential use only, so I chose the library for my paid workshops.
examples.zh: 租约写着「仅限居住用途」，所以我选了图书馆来办收费工作坊。

examples.en: We asked whether the words residential use only would affect occasional video calls with clients.
examples.zh: 我们问「仅限居住用途」这几个字会不会影响偶尔和客户开视频会。

words.enDefinition: a lease provision regulating changes to the property

examples.en: I reread the alterations clause before drilling holes for shelves in the study area.
examples.zh: 在书桌区打孔装架子前，我又看了一遍「改装条款」。

examples.en: The alterations clause lets us repaint if we use a color approved in advance.
examples.zh: 按「改装条款」，我们可以重新刷墙，但要用事先批准的颜色。

collocations: an alterations clause in the lease

words.enDefinition: required permission given in writing before an action

examples.en: Our lease requires prior written consent before we can install a lock on the bedroom door.
examples.zh: 租约规定，给卧室门加锁前必须取得「事先书面同意」。

examples.en: I obtained prior written consent to mount a small bookshelf above the desk in my room.
examples.zh: 我在房间书桌上方装小书架之前，取得了「事先书面同意」。

words.enDefinition: to decline to give permission for something

examples.en: Would the landlord withhold consent if we asked to share the flat with another student?
examples.zh: 如果我们申请再和一位学生合租，房东会「拒绝同意」吗？

examples.en: The manager agreed not to withhold consent once we explained how the change would work.
examples.zh: 我们解释了具体怎么改之后，物业经理答应不会「拒绝同意」。

collocations: reserve the right to withhold consent

words.enDefinition: the circumstances in which a landlord may enter

examples.en: I checked the landlord's right of entry after a contractor arrived while I was in class.
examples.zh: 维修人员在我上课时到了，我就去查了「房东入内权」的规定。

examples.en: The adviser explained the landlord's right of entry before I decided what to ask the agent.
examples.zh: 顾问先解释了「房东入内权」，我才决定要问中介什么。

collocations: limits on the landlord's right of entry
explain the landlord's right of entry
exercise the landlord's right of entry

words.enDefinition: advance warning that gives someone enough time to prepare

examples.en: I asked the landlord for reasonable notice before sending anyone to check the bathroom leak.
examples.zh: 我请房东派人检查浴室漏水前，给我「合理的提前通知」。

examples.en: With reasonable notice, I can arrange to be home when the repair crew comes.
examples.zh: 只要收到「合理的提前通知」，我就能在维修人员来时安排自己在家。

words.enDefinition: access to a property in an urgent situation

examples.en: The lease mentions emergency entry for situations such as a burst pipe in the apartment.
examples.zh: 租约提到，公寓水管爆裂之类的情况允许「紧急进入」。

examples.en: I asked who records an emergency entry when the tenant is away on a trip.
examples.zh: 我问租客外出旅行时，谁负责记录「紧急进入」的情况。

words.enDefinition: the right to occupy a home without undue interference

examples.en: The student adviser explained the right to quiet enjoyment after repeated unannounced visits from management.
examples.zh: 物业多次不打招呼就上门后，学生顾问解释了「安宁使用房屋的权利」。

examples.en: I asked whether the frequent surprise showings affected my right to quiet enjoyment as a tenant.
examples.zh: 我想知道经常突然带人来看房，会不会影响我作为租客「安宁使用房屋的权利」。

collocations: protect the right to quiet enjoyment
interfere with the right to quiet enjoyment
exercise the right to quiet enjoyment

words.enDefinition: a legal assurance that a rental is fit to live in

examples.en: The housing clinic mentioned the warranty of habitability when we described the lack of heating.
examples.zh: 我们说了暖气用不了的情况，住房咨询点就提到了「适居性保证」。

examples.en: I looked up the warranty of habitability after water kept leaking into my bedroom.
examples.zh: 水一直漏进卧室，我就去查了「适居性保证」。

collocations: claims under the warranty of habitability

words.enDefinition: the duties a renter must fulfill under an agreement

examples.en: I read the section on tenant obligations to find out who should replace smoke alarm batteries.
examples.zh: 我看了「租客义务」一节，想知道该由谁更换烟雾报警器的电池。

examples.en: The adviser helped us understand which tenant obligations apply when we share a kitchen.
examples.zh: 顾问帮我们弄明白了共用厨房时有哪些「租客义务」。

words.enDefinition: duties the owner owes to renters under an agreement

examples.en: I checked the landlord obligations in our lease after the building's front lock stopped working.
examples.zh: 楼门锁坏了以后，我看了租约关于「房东义务」的规定。

examples.en: The student guide covers landlord obligations for common areas in buildings with several rented flats.
examples.zh: 学生指南介绍了一栋楼里有多套出租公寓时，公共区域方面的「房东义务」。

words.enDefinition: regular work that keeps property in good condition

examples.en: The manager will give us a week's notice before routine maintenance on the building's heating system.
examples.zh: 大楼供暖系统做「日常维护」前，物业经理会提前一周通知我们。

examples.en: I asked whether changing the air filter counts as routine maintenance under my apartment lease.
examples.zh: 我问按公寓租约，更换空气滤网算不算「日常维护」。

words.enDefinition: a lease rule against conduct that seriously disturbs others

examples.en: We read the nuisance clause after a neighbor complained about our late-night gatherings upstairs.
examples.zh: 楼下邻居投诉我们深夜聚会后，我们看了「禁止扰邻条款」。

examples.en: The owner referred to the nuisance clause when she asked us to stop blocking the hallway.
examples.zh: 房东让我们别再堵住走廊时，提到了「禁止扰邻条款」。

words.enDefinition: rules governing the amount or timing of noise

examples.en: The agent explained the noise restrictions after I asked if I could practice violin at home.
examples.zh: 我问能不能在家练小提琴，中介就解释了「噪声限制」。

examples.en: Our building has noise restrictions that apply even on weekends during the exam period.
examples.zh: 考试期间，我们这栋楼的「噪声限制」周末也适用。

words.enDefinition: an individual rule or condition in a rental contract

examples.en: A lease provision lets us keep bicycles in a locked room on the ground floor.
examples.zh: 一项「租约规定」允许我们把自行车停在底层一个上锁的房间里。

examples.en: I asked the adviser how to interpret the lease provision about renewing after graduation.
examples.zh: 我请顾问解释毕业后续租的那项「租约规定」。

words.enDefinition: conditions added to the main set of contractual rules

examples.en: We found additional terms about shared laundry facilities on the last page of the lease.
examples.zh: 我们在租约最后一页发现了共用洗衣设施的「附加条款」。

examples.en: I checked the additional terms carefully before agreeing to keep an indoor cat in my room.
examples.zh: 我仔细看过「附加条款」，才同意把猫养在自己房间里。

words.enDefinition: contract conditions that cannot both be followed or applied

examples.en: The adviser flagged conflicting terms about whether visitors could stay longer than a week in March.
examples.zh: 顾问指出，一些条款对三月访客能否留宿超过一周「规定相互冲突」。

examples.en: We found conflicting terms in the lease and the attachment about where to park bikes.
examples.zh: 关于自行车停在哪里，租约和附件里有「相互冲突的条款」。

words.enDefinition: a contract condition that unreasonably favors one party

examples.en: I asked the housing clinic whether that restriction on visitors might be an unfair term.
examples.zh: 我问住房咨询点，那项对访客的限制算不算「不公平条款」。

examples.en: Ravi pointed out a potentially unfair term and asked the agent to explain its purpose.
examples.zh: 拉维指出一项可能的「不公平条款」，请中介解释为什么要加这一条。

words.enDefinition: a provision preserving the contract when part is invalid

examples.en: I asked the adviser why our residential lease had a severability clause near the signature page.
examples.zh: 我问顾问，为什么住宅租约靠近签字页的地方有「可分割性条款」。

examples.en: The severability clause explains what happens to the rest of the agreement if one condition is invalid.
examples.zh: 「可分割性条款」说明了某项条件无效时，协议的其他部分如何处理。

words.enDefinition: a provision identifying the document as the complete agreement

examples.en: The adviser explained the entire agreement clause before I relied on something the agent had said.
examples.zh: 顾问先解释了「完整协议条款」，免得我轻信中介之前的口头说法。

examples.en: Our lease has an entire agreement clause, so we asked to include the promised bicycle storage.
examples.zh: 租约有「完整协议条款」，所以我们要求把承诺的自行车存放处写进去。

collocations: rely on the entire agreement clause

words.enDefinition: contract conditions that the parties can discuss and change

examples.en: I asked which parts of the draft were negotiable terms before my meeting with management.
examples.zh: 和物业见面前，我问了草案里哪些是「可协商条款」。

examples.en: The landlord listed a few negotiable terms, including how long our visitors could stay.
examples.zh: 房东列出了几项「可协商条款」，其中包括访客可以留宿多久。

words.enDefinition: a document that adds terms to an existing lease

examples.en: The landlord put the bike storage arrangement in a lease addendum that we signed separately.
examples.zh: 房东把自行车存放安排写进了一份「租约补充文件」，我们单独签了字。

examples.en: Please check whether the lease addendum covers our agreement to install a second desk.
examples.zh: 请确认「租约补充文件」里是否写了我们同意再装一张书桌的事。

words.enDefinition: a document that changes terms in an existing lease

examples.en: We used a lease amendment to correct the apartment number without replacing the whole agreement.
examples.zh: 我们用「租约修订文件」纠正了公寓门牌号，整份合同不用重签。

examples.en: The lease amendment reflects the date we agreed on after my exchange placement changed.
examples.zh: 我交换项目的安排有变，「租约修订文件」上写的是后来商定的日期。

words.enDefinition: to mark every page with one's initials

examples.en: The agent asked us to initial each page before signing our full names at the end.
examples.zh: 中介让我们「在每页签上姓名首字母」，最后一页再签全名。

examples.en: We took turns at the kitchen table to initial each page of the updated lease.
examples.zh: 我们轮流坐在厨房桌边，「在新版租约的每一页签上姓名首字母」。

collocations: initial each page of the lease

words.enDefinition: to add a confirming signature to the lease

examples.en: The building manager will countersign the lease after both roommates have signed their parts.
examples.zh: 两位室友各自签字后，物业经理会「在租约上加签确认」。

examples.en: I asked when the landlord would countersign the lease because I needed a completed copy.
examples.zh: 我需要完整的副本，就问房东什么时候「在租约上加签确认」。

collocations: countersign the lease after the tenant

words.enDefinition: a lease formally signed by all required parties

examples.en: The international student office asked for a fully executed lease as evidence of my address.
examples.zh: 国际学生办公室要求提供一份「各方签署完毕的租约」作为地址证明。

examples.en: Our agent filed the fully executed lease and gave each roommate a copy to keep.
examples.zh: 中介存档了「各方签署完毕的租约」，并给每位室友留了一份。

collocations: a copy of the fully executed lease

words.enDefinition: liability enforceable against any of several responsible parties

examples.en: The adviser explained joint and several liability after my roommate asked to leave the lease.
examples.zh: 我室友提出退出租约后，顾问给我解释了「连带责任」。

examples.en: Before signing, I asked whether joint and several liability applied to damage in shared areas.
examples.zh: 签字前，我问公共区域的损坏是否适用「连带责任」。

collocations: a joint and several liability clause

words.enDefinition: a rental contract held separately by one resident

examples.en: I signed an individual lease for my room rather than sharing one agreement with everyone.
examples.zh: 我为自己的房间签了一份「单独租约」，没有和大家共用一份合同。

examples.en: The manager offered an individual lease to each student in the four-bedroom apartment near campus.
examples.zh: 物业经理给校区附近那套四居公寓的每个学生都提供了一份「单独租约」。

collocations: an individual lease for each bedroom

words.enDefinition: one rental contract signed by several tenants together

examples.en: We signed a joint lease after our adviser explained what it meant to share responsibility.
examples.zh: 顾问讲清如何共同担责后，我们签了「共同租约」。

examples.en: Could we ask the agent whether a joint lease would suit the three of us?
examples.zh: 我们能问问中介，签一份「共同租约」适不适合我们三个人吗？

collocations: be named on a joint lease

words.enDefinition: a rental contract for a specified length of time

examples.en: My fixed-term lease runs through July, even though my course finishes at the end of May.
examples.zh: 虽然我的课五月底就结束，「固定期限租约」却要到七月底。

examples.en: They offered a fixed-term lease that matched the dates of our university exchange program.
examples.zh: 对方提供了一份「固定期限租约」，正好覆盖我们的大学交换项目。

collocations: the end of a fixed-term lease

words.enDefinition: a rental arrangement that continues one month at a time

examples.en: A month-to-month tenancy gave me time to decide where I wanted to live after graduation.
examples.zh: 「按月续期的租赁」让我有时间决定毕业后住在哪里。

examples.en: I asked the agent if a month-to-month tenancy was possible during the summer placement.
examples.zh: 我问中介，暑期实习期间能不能「按月续期租住」。

words.enDefinition: a tenancy that continues from one rental period to another

examples.en: The adviser showed me which notice rules apply to a periodic tenancy where I live.
examples.zh: 顾问给我看了我这里「周期性租赁」适用的通知规定。

examples.en: The agreement describes a periodic tenancy that continues weekly until one party properly ends it.
examples.zh: 合同写的是「周期性租赁」，按周延续，直到一方按程序终止。

words.enDefinition: the period for which a rental agreement is in effect

examples.en: We asked for a shorter lease term to match the length of our research placement.
examples.zh: 为了配合科研实习时间，我们要求缩短「租约期限」。

examples.en: Before signing, I checked whether the lease term covered the entire academic year in Toronto.
examples.zh: 签字前，我确认了「租约期限」是否覆盖我在多伦多的整个学年。

words.enDefinition: the first period of an agreement before any renewal

examples.en: Once the initial term ended, I asked to remain in the flat for another semester.
examples.zh: 「初始租期」结束后，我提出在公寓里再住一学期。

examples.en: The agent said the initial term would run from September to the end of June.
examples.zh: 中介说「初始租期」从九月开始，持续到六月底。

words.enDefinition: the shortest period required under a rental arrangement

examples.en: I chose a different room because the minimum term was longer than my exchange program.
examples.zh: 我另外选了一个房间，因为这里的「最短租期」比我的交换项目还长。

examples.en: We asked whether the minimum term applied if we joined the lease in March.
examples.zh: 我们问如果三月加入租约，「最短租期」的规定还适不适用。

collocations: a minimum term of six months

words.enDefinition: the date on which a rental agreement takes effect

examples.en: The commencement date falls on a Tuesday, two days after I arrive in town.
examples.zh: 「租约起始日」是星期二，在我到这座城市之后两天。

examples.en: The agent corrected the commencement date after I showed her the email confirming September first.
examples.zh: 我给中介看了确认九月一日的邮件，她就改了「租约起始日」。

words.enDefinition: the date when the agreed rental period ends

examples.en: I put the lease end date in my phone so I could plan my flight.
examples.zh: 我把「租约到期日」存进手机，方便安排航班。

examples.en: Please confirm the lease end date before I book a van to move my things.
examples.zh: 请先确认「租约到期日」，我再预约搬东西用的货车。

words.enDefinition: the date the tenant may take control of the property

examples.en: The possession date is two days before orientation, so I can unpack over the weekend.
examples.zh: 「可接收房屋的日期」在迎新前两天，我可以周末拆箱整理。

examples.en: The manager moved the possession date forward after the previous tenant returned the keys early.
examples.zh: 上一位租客提前交还钥匙后，物业经理把「可接收房屋的日期」提前了。

words.enDefinition: to obtain control and use of the rented property

examples.en: We can take possession on Friday if the cleaner has finished and the keys are ready.
examples.zh: 如果保洁已经做完、钥匙也准备好了，我们星期五就能「接收房屋」。

examples.en: Before we take possession, the agent wants us to confirm who will collect the keys.
examples.zh: 我们「接收房屋」前，中介希望先确认谁会去拿钥匙。

words.enDefinition: handover of a property free of occupants and belongings

examples.en: The tenancy adviser explained vacant possession after I found boxes in the room at handover.
examples.zh: 我交接时发现房里还有箱子，租赁顾问就解释了「腾空交付」的意思。

examples.en: We asked for vacant possession because the previous tenant had left furniture we did not want.
examples.zh: 前租客留下了我们不需要的家具，所以我们要求「腾空交付」。

words.enDefinition: the right to occupy premises and exclude others

examples.en: The clinic explained exclusive possession when I asked whether my landlord could use my bedroom.
examples.zh: 我问房东能不能使用我的卧室，咨询点解释了「排他性占有权」。

examples.en: My agreement gives me exclusive possession of the bedroom while I share the kitchen.
examples.zh: 按合同，我对卧室有「排他性占有权」，厨房则和别人共用。

words.enDefinition: to live in the property specified in an agreement

examples.en: The lease says only the people named in the agreement may occupy the premises.
examples.zh: 租约写明，只有合同上列名的人才可以「居住在该处房屋」。

examples.en: We asked whether a visiting researcher could occupy the premises while we were abroad.
examples.zh: 我们问出国期间，能否让一位访问研究人员「居住在该处房屋」。

collocations: be permitted to occupy the premises
occupy the premises as a residence

words.enDefinition: the part of the agreed rental period still left

examples.en: My friend offered to take over the remaining term when I transferred to another campus.
examples.zh: 我转到另一个校区时，朋友提出接手「剩余租期」。

examples.en: The adviser told us to check the remaining term before looking for a replacement roommate.
examples.zh: 顾问让我们先确认「剩余租期」，再去找接替的室友。

words.enDefinition: bringing an agreement to an end before its scheduled expiry

examples.en: I asked about early termination after receiving an offer to study abroad in January.
examples.zh: 我收到一月出国交换的录取通知后，询问了「提前终止」租约的事。

examples.en: Our housing adviser explained early termination before we decided whether to leave the flat in May.
examples.zh: 决定要不要五月搬离公寓前，住房顾问解释了「提前终止」租约的情况。

words.enDefinition: a document recording mutual consent to end an arrangement

examples.en: We signed a termination agreement that confirmed the room would be empty by Friday.
examples.zh: 我们签了份「终止协议」，确认在星期五前腾空房间。

examples.en: The adviser checked the termination agreement before we gave the apartment keys back to management.
examples.zh: 我们把公寓钥匙交还给物业前，顾问审查了「终止协议」。

words.enDefinition: the effective date on which an agreement ends

examples.en: The termination date in the letter differs from the day I planned to move out.
examples.zh: 信里的「终止日期」和我计划搬出的日子不一样。

examples.en: I asked the landlord to confirm the termination date before handing over my keys.
examples.zh: 我请房东先确认「终止日期」，再交还钥匙。

words.enDefinition: a lease provision allowing early termination under specified conditions

examples.en: I checked the break clause before accepting a placement in another city for the spring term.
examples.zh: 我去另一个城市做春季实习之前，先看了「提前解约条款」。

examples.en: The landlord and I discussed adding a break clause because my course dates might change.
examples.zh: 我的课程时间可能会变，我和房东讨论了加一项「提前解约条款」。

words.enDefinition: continuation for another period without a new agreement

examples.en: I checked for automatic renewal before assuming the lease would end with my last exam.
examples.zh: 我没急着认定租约会随最后一门考试结束，先看了有没有「自动续约」。

examples.en: The manager explained how automatic renewal worked when I asked whether I needed to sign again.
examples.zh: 我问还要不要再签字，物业经理解释了「自动续约」的流程。

words.enDefinition: a contract provision governing continuation for another term

examples.en: The renewal clause tells us when we need to ask about staying for another year.
examples.zh: 「续期条款」写明了我们最晚什么时候该问能不能再住一年。

examples.en: I read the renewal clause because the agent had mentioned different terms for returning students.
examples.zh: 中介提到续住学生的条件不同，我就看了「续期条款」。

words.enDefinition: the right to continue an agreement under specified conditions

examples.en: I decided to exercise my renewal option once I knew I'd be studying here again.
examples.zh: 知道自己还会在这里上学后，我决定行使「续期选择权」。

examples.en: The adviser showed me where the renewal option was described in the apartment agreement.
examples.zh: 顾问给我指出了公寓合同里关于「续期选择权」的位置。

words.enDefinition: the period an agreement runs after it is renewed

examples.en: We asked for a six-month renewal term because we all expect to graduate next summer.
examples.zh: 我们预计明年夏天都毕业，所以要求把「续约租期」定为六个月。

examples.en: Please check the renewal term before you sign the new paperwork at the office.
examples.zh: 去办公室签新文件之前，请确认一下「续约租期」。

words.enDefinition: a formal statement that a lease will not renew

examples.en: I saved the notice of nonrenewal and asked the adviser to explain the next steps.
examples.zh: 我保存了「不续租通知」，并请顾问解释接下来该怎么办。

examples.en: We sent a notice of nonrenewal before moving to a different campus for our final year.
examples.zh: 最后一学年转到另一个校区之前，我们发了「不续租通知」。

words.enDefinition: a proposal to continue a rental agreement

examples.en: The landlord made an offer to renew shortly before we left for the winter break.
examples.zh: 寒假离开前不久，房东提出了「续租提议」。

examples.en: I wanted to compare the offer to renew with the lease for a room nearer campus.
examples.zh: 我想把这份「续租提议」和另一个离学校更近的房间的租约比一比。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement that lengthens the existing agreement's duration

examples.en: My thesis defense was postponed, so I asked the landlord for a short lease extension.
examples.zh: 论文答辩推迟了，我就问房东能不能短期「延长租约」。

examples.en: The manager confirmed a lease extension through September after the incoming tenant changed her plans.
examples.zh: 新租客改了计划，物业经理确认可以「延长租约」到九月底。

words.enDefinition: the continuation of a lease for a new term

examples.en: I saved the email about lease renewal so my roommate could read it after her class.
examples.zh: 我留着有关「租约续签」的邮件，让室友下课后也能看。

examples.en: The leasing office handles lease renewal once students confirm they are staying for another year.
examples.zh: 学生确认要再住一年后，租赁办公室会办理「租约续签」。

words.enDefinition: a formal notice intended to end a tenancy

examples.en: I took the notice to quit to the student housing adviser the morning it arrived.
examples.zh: 收到「终止租赁通知」的当天早上，我就拿给了学生住房顾问。

examples.en: As a lodger, I asked my live-in landlord to explain the date on the notice to quit.
examples.zh: 身为与房东同住的房客，我请房东解释「终止租赁通知」上的日期。

words.enDefinition: formal information recorded in writing and sent to someone

examples.en: Our agreement calls for written notice before a scheduled inspection of the shared flat.
examples.zh: 合同要求安排合租公寓检查时提前发出「书面通知」。

examples.en: I received written notice of the manager's planned visit while I was working in the library.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆工作时收到了物业经理计划上门的「书面通知」。

words.enDefinition: to formally tell someone of a planned change or departure

examples.en: I need to give notice before I book a room near my new campus.
examples.zh: 我得先「正式告知房东我要搬走」，再订新校区附近的房间。

examples.en: The landlord agreed to give notice before sending someone to repair the ceiling in our room.
examples.zh: 房东同意先「正式通知我们」，再派人修房间的天花板。

words.enDefinition: to deliver a formal notice by a recognized method

examples.en: The adviser showed me how to serve notice under the terms of my lease.
examples.zh: 顾问告诉我如何按租约规定「正式送达通知」。

examples.en: We agreed to serve notice in the way described on the first page of the agreement.
examples.zh: 我们约定按合同第一页写的方式「正式送达通知」。

words.enDefinition: a formal notice that the property is to be vacated

examples.en: I brought the notice to vacate to the adviser because I wasn't sure what it required.
examples.zh: 我把「搬离通知」拿给顾问看，因为不确定具体要求是什么。

examples.en: The notice to vacate listed a date that fell right in the middle of my exams.
examples.zh: 「搬离通知」上写的日期恰好在我的考试周中间。

collocations: respond to a notice to vacate

words.enDefinition: a tenant's formal statement of plans to leave

examples.en: We emailed our notice of intent to vacate as soon as we confirmed our flights home.
examples.zh: 我们一确认回国的航班，就发邮件提交了「拟搬离通知」。

examples.en: The portal lets students submit a notice of intent to vacate directly to the leasing office.
examples.zh: 学生可以在门户网站上直接向租赁办公室提交「拟搬离通知」。

collocations: submit a notice of intent to vacate
acknowledge a notice of intent to vacate
file a notice of intent to vacate

words.enDefinition: the point at which a formal notification is received

examples.en: The agent confirmed receipt of notice and emailed me a copy for my own record.
examples.zh: 中介确认「已收到通知」，并发给我一份副本留存。

examples.en: I asked for confirmation of receipt of notice after the online form disappeared from my account.
examples.zh: 在线表单在我的账户里找不到了，我就请对方确认是否「已收到通知」。

words.enDefinition: evidence that a formal document was properly delivered

examples.en: I kept proof of service in case there was a dispute over when I gave notice.
examples.zh: 我留存了「送达证明」，以防送达通知的时间出现争议。

examples.en: The clinic asked for proof of service before looking at the dates on my notice.
examples.zh: 咨询点请我先提供「送达证明」，再核对通知上的日期。

words.enDefinition: the designated address for receiving formal documents

examples.en: I checked the address for service before mailing the notice to the management company.
examples.zh: 把通知寄给物业公司前，我核对了「法律文件送达地址」。

examples.en: The landlord changed the address for service and notified everyone living in the shared flat.
examples.zh: 房东变更了「法律文件送达地址」，并通知了合租公寓的每个住户。

collocations: send notices to the address for service

words.enDefinition: to leave the property and remove one's belongings

examples.en: Our letter says to vacate the premises by Friday, so we booked a moving van.
examples.zh: 信上说星期五前要「腾退房屋」，我们就预约了搬家车。

examples.en: We need to vacate the premises before the agent can meet the new tenants there.
examples.zh: 我们得先「腾退房屋」，中介才能在那里和新租客见面。

collocations: be required to vacate the premises
vacate the premises by the agreed date

words.enDefinition: to give up the lease with the landlord's agreement

examples.en: We asked whether we could surrender the lease after our study program ended earlier than planned.
examples.zh: 学习项目提前结束后，我们问能不能「协议退租」。

examples.en: The landlord agreed we could surrender the lease once we settled on a handover date.
examples.zh: 房东同意，只要确定交接日期，我们就可以「协议退租」。

words.enDefinition: a formal deed recording an agreement to end a tenancy

examples.en: The housing clinic explained the deed of surrender before I signed it with my landlord.
examples.zh: 我和房东在「租约退租契据」上签字前，住房咨询点给我解释了这份文件。

examples.en: We both kept a copy of the deed of surrender in case questions came up later.
examples.zh: 我们双方都保存了一份「租约退租契据」，以免以后有疑问。

collocations: keep a copy of the deed of surrender

words.enDefinition: a formal discharge from an existing legal obligation

examples.en: I asked for a written release from liability before my replacement signed the new agreement.
examples.zh: 接替我的租客签新合同前，我要求房东出具一份书面的「免除责任」文件。

examples.en: The adviser checked whether the release from liability covered damage reported after I moved out.
examples.zh: 顾问确认了「免除责任」的范围是否包括我搬出后才报修的损坏。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of a tenant's lease interest to someone else

examples.en: My classmate asked about a lease assignment when I said I was transferring universities.
examples.zh: 我说要转学时，同学问能不能办理「租约转让」。

examples.en: The landlord wanted to meet my replacement before approving the lease assignment we had requested.
examples.zh: 房东想先见见接替我的租客，再批准我们申请的「租约转让」。

words.enDefinition: permission to transfer a lease to another tenant

examples.en: I asked when the landlord would give consent to assignment so I could plan my move.
examples.zh: 我问房东何时会给「转让租约的许可」，这样我好安排搬家。

examples.en: The office confirmed consent to assignment after checking my replacement's enrollment letter and references.
examples.zh: 办公室核对了接替我的租客的在读证明和推荐材料，随后确认给予「转让租约的许可」。

words.enDefinition: a lease provision governing rental to another occupant

examples.en: I checked the subletting clause before offering my room to a friend for the summer.
examples.zh: 我先看了「转租条款」，才提出暑假把房间租给朋友。

examples.en: The agent highlighted the subletting clause because my summer travel plans were still uncertain.
examples.zh: 我的暑期出行计划还没定，中介就标出了「转租条款」。

collocations: a subletting clause in the lease

words.enDefinition: a contract between a current tenant and a subtenant

examples.en: We signed a subletting agreement that says exactly when the room must be handed back.
examples.zh: 我们签了「转租协议」，里面明确写了什么时候必须交还房间。

examples.en: The housing adviser checked my subletting agreement before the visiting student arrived for her placement.
examples.zh: 来实习的学生到之前，住房顾问审查了我的「转租协议」。

words.enDefinition: to rent a room onward as its current tenant

examples.en: I hope to sublet a room in our flat while I am away doing fieldwork.
examples.zh: 我去外地做田野调查期间，希望能把公寓里的「一间房转租出去」。

examples.en: My friend needed permission to sublet a room before she left for an internship in Glasgow.
examples.zh: 朋友去格拉斯哥实习前，要先拿到「转租一间房」的许可。

collocations: request permission to sublet a room
sublet a room for the summer

words.enDefinition: renting out a leased property without required permission

examples.en: The manager sent a letter about unauthorized subletting after seeing an online listing for our rooms.
examples.zh: 物业经理看到网上有人挂出了我们的房间，就发了封关于「未经许可的转租」的信。

examples.en: The adviser explained what the lease says about unauthorized subletting before I posted my summer listing.
examples.zh: 我发布暑期转租信息前，顾问解释了租约关于「未经许可的转租」的规定。

words.enDefinition: a tenant who rents leased space to another person

examples.en: The agreement lists my roommate as the sublessor because she holds the original lease.
examples.zh: 协议上我室友是「转租出租人」，因为原租约是她签的。

examples.en: I asked the sublessor for a copy of the written permission from the apartment manager.
examples.zh: 我请「转租出租人」给我一份公寓物业经理的书面许可。

words.enDefinition: to bring the rental arrangement to an end

examples.en: We asked the adviser how to end the tenancy before moving into university housing.
examples.zh: 搬进学校宿舍前，我们问顾问怎么「结束租赁关系」。

examples.en: My landlord agreed to end the tenancy once I had returned both sets of keys.
examples.zh: 房东同意，在我交还两套钥匙后「结束租赁关系」。

collocations: move out and end the tenancy

words.zhGloss: 租期届满后留住的租客
words.enDefinition: a renter who remains after the lease term expires
acceptedZhAnswers: 租期届满后留住的租客

examples.en: The adviser explained what a holdover tenant was when I asked to stay another week.
examples.zh: 我问能不能多住一周，顾问解释了什么是「租期届满后仍留住的租客」。

examples.en: The handbook discusses a holdover tenant staying in the apartment after the agreed term expires.
examples.zh: 手册介绍了「租期届满后仍留住的租客」继续住在公寓里的情况。

words.enDefinition: a lease provision addressing occupancy after the term ends

examples.en: I checked the holdover clause when my new room would not be ready until October.
examples.zh: 我的新房间要到十月才准备好，我就去看了「租期届满后留住条款」。

examples.en: The manager explained the holdover clause after I asked about staying beyond the end date.
examples.zh: 我问过了截止日期能不能继续住，物业经理解释了「租期届满后留住条款」。

words.enDefinition: failure to fulfill an obligation in a rental contract

examples.en: My adviser explained which facts might count as a breach of lease under the agreement.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了按这份合同哪些情况可能算「违反租约」。

examples.en: The manager called the unauthorized alteration a breach of lease and asked us to restore the wall.
examples.zh: 物业经理说擅自改装属于「违反租约」，并要求我们把墙恢复原状。

words.enDefinition: a failure that substantially undermines an agreement

examples.en: The adviser asked which obligation I thought was serious enough to constitute a material breach.
examples.zh: 顾问问我，哪项义务没履行的后果严重到足以构成「重大违约」。

examples.en: We read the letter together because the term material breach was new to both of us.
examples.zh: 我们一起看了那封信，因为两个人都没见过「重大违约」这个词。

words.enDefinition: formal notice requiring correction of an alleged contract violation

examples.en: I received a notice to cure after storing my bicycle in the building's fire exit.
examples.zh: 我把自行车放在大楼消防出口后，收到了「违约整改通知」。

examples.en: The student adviser helped me read the notice to cure and note the deadline.
examples.zh: 学生顾问帮我读了「违约整改通知」，并记下截止日期。

collocations: respond to a notice to cure

words.enDefinition: the time allowed to correct a reported contract violation

examples.en: The notice describes a cure period for removing my belongings from the common hallway.
examples.zh: 通知写明了「违约整改期限」，要求我在期限内把东西从公共走廊清走。

examples.en: I asked the adviser when the cure period began because I was away that week.
examples.zh: 那周我不在，就问顾问「违约整改期限」从什么时候开始算。

words.enDefinition: a formal notice starting or warning of eviction

examples.en: I took the eviction notice to the campus housing office to ask what it meant.
examples.zh: 我把「驱逐通知」拿到学校住房办公室，询问具体是什么意思。

examples.en: The adviser explained the difference between an eviction notice and an order from a court.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「驱逐通知」和法院命令有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: a formal legal process seeking removal of a tenant

examples.en: The adviser explained what eviction proceedings might involve before my roommate spoke to the landlord.
examples.zh: 室友找房东沟通之前，顾问解释了「驱逐租客程序」里可能有哪些环节。

examples.en: I kept copies of our emails because the landlord had mentioned starting eviction proceedings.
examples.zh: 房东提到要启动「驱逐租客程序」，我就保存了我们的邮件副本。

words.enDefinition: an official decision requiring a tenant to leave

examples.en: I asked the legal clinic whether the document I received was actually an eviction order.
examples.zh: 我问法律咨询点，我收到的文件是不是真正的「强制迁出令」。

examples.en: The handbook explains which authority can issue an eviction order in the city where I study.
examples.zh: 手册说明了我上学的城市里，哪个机构可以签发「强制迁出令」。

words.enDefinition: removal of a tenant without following legal requirements

examples.en: The adviser asked whether I could document the events surrounding the suspected unlawful eviction.
examples.zh: 顾问问我能不能记录下涉嫌「非法驱逐租客」的事情经过。

examples.en: The student handbook lists organizations that can help renters dealing with a possible unlawful eviction.
examples.zh: 学生手册列出了可以帮助疑似遭遇「非法驱逐」的租客的机构。

words.zhGloss: 非法换锁拒绝租客进入
words.enDefinition: unlawful exclusion of a tenant by blocking access
acceptedZhAnswers: 非法换锁拒绝租客进入

examples.en: After finding my key no longer worked, I asked the clinic about a possible illegal lockout.
examples.zh: 发现钥匙打不开门后，我咨询了法律服务点，问这是否涉嫌「非法换锁拒绝租客进入」。

examples.en: The housing office asked whether the landlord had changed the locks before discussing an illegal lockout.
examples.zh: 住房办公室在讨论是否存在「非法换锁拒绝租客进入」前，先问房东有没有换锁。

words.enDefinition: a landlord's interference that effectively forces a tenant out

examples.en: The clinic mentioned constructive eviction when I said the landlord had made the room unlivable.
examples.zh: 我说房东让房间变得没法住，法律咨询点提到了「迫使租客搬离」。

examples.en: My adviser explained why a claim of constructive eviction depends on more than ordinary inconvenience.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了为什么单有日常不便，还不能认定房东「迫使租客搬离」。

words.enDefinition: legal protections and entitlements available to a renter

examples.en: Our university runs a free workshop on tenant rights at the start of every semester.
examples.zh: 我们大学每学期开学都会办一场免费的「租客权利」讲座。

examples.en: I read about tenant rights after the management company stopped answering repair requests from our flat.
examples.zh: 物业公司不再回复我们公寓的报修申请后，我查了「租客权利」。

words.enDefinition: an organization formed to represent and support tenants

examples.en: I joined the tenant union after talking to other students who rent near the station.
examples.zh: 同住在车站附近的其他学生聊过之后，我加入了「租客联合会」。

examples.en: The tenant union organized a meeting about recurring maintenance problems across buildings in our neighborhood.
examples.zh: 「租客联合会」就我们社区多栋楼反复出现的维修问题组织了一次会议。

words.enDefinition: a body that hears and decides housing disputes

examples.en: The adviser helped me prepare copies of my emails before the housing tribunal hearing.
examples.zh: 「住房纠纷裁决机构」举行听证之前，顾问帮我准备了邮件副本。

examples.en: We asked which housing tribunal could hear a complaint about our off-campus rental agreement.
examples.zh: 我们问哪个「住房纠纷裁决机构」能受理与校外租房合同有关的投诉。

collocations: refer a case to the housing tribunal

words.enDefinition: a disagreement between parties to a rental arrangement

examples.en: I brought our emails to a campus advice session about a tenancy dispute with my landlord.
examples.zh: 我带上往来邮件，参加了校内咨询，讨论我和房东的「租赁纠纷」。

examples.en: The tenancy dispute started when the landlord refused to let us use the promised storage space.
examples.zh: 房东不让我们使用原先承诺的储物空间，「租赁纠纷」就这样开始了。

words.enDefinition: a provision directing parties to try facilitated negotiation

examples.en: The adviser pointed to the mediation clause when I asked how we could resolve the disagreement.
examples.zh: 我问怎么解决分歧，顾问指给我看了「调解条款」。

examples.en: I checked what the mediation clause said before contacting the neighborhood housing advice service.
examples.zh: 我先看了「调解条款」的内容，再联系社区的住房咨询服务。

words.enDefinition: a service offering legal help to eligible people

examples.en: A fellow student told me the legal aid clinic could read my rental agreement with me.
examples.zh: 另一位同学说，「法律援助咨询点」可以和我一起看租房合同。

examples.en: I called the legal aid clinic after my landlord sent an unexpected letter about the lease.
examples.zh: 房东突然发来一封有关租约的信，我就打电话给「法律援助咨询点」。

collocations: an appointment at a legal aid clinic

words.enDefinition: a signature confirming that someone observed a document being signed

examples.en: The agent showed me where to put the witness signature on the last page of the form.
examples.zh: 中介指给我看，表格最后一页哪里需要「见证人签名」。

examples.en: I checked whether the witness signature was required before sending the agreement back to the landlord.
examples.zh: 我先确认是否需要「见证人签名」，再把合同发回给房东。

words.enDefinition: the section of a document reserved for signing details

examples.en: My surname was misspelled in the signature block, so I asked for a fresh copy.
examples.zh: 「签名栏」里我的姓拼错了，我就要求换一份。

examples.en: The agent added a separate signature block for each roommate at the end of the lease.
examples.zh: 中介在租约末尾给每个室友加了一个独立的「签名栏」。

words.enDefinition: the date on which a person signs a document

examples.en: The date of signature is on the final page, next to the name of the landlord.
examples.zh: 「签署日期」在最后一页，紧挨着房东的姓名。

examples.en: I entered the date of signature after the portal prompted me to confirm my details.
examples.zh: 门户网站提示我确认信息后，我填了「签署日期」。

words.enDefinition: an electronic signature used to sign a digital document such as a lease

examples.en: The specialist verified the landlord's digital signature before releasing the lease to my university housing adviser.
examples.zh: 把租约发给我的学校住房顾问前，工作人员核验了房东的「电子签名」。

examples.en: The portal let me verify the digital signature on the landlord's copy of the lease.
examples.zh: 我在门户网站上核验了房东那份租约上的「电子签名」。

words.enDefinition: signing separate copies that together form one agreement

examples.en: The agent suggested signing in counterparts because my two roommates were still in different countries.
examples.zh: 两位室友还在不同国家，中介建议「各自签署合同副本」。

examples.en: We asked whether signing in counterparts meant we each kept an identical version of the lease.
examples.zh: 我们问「分签合同副本」是不是指每个人都留一份内容相同的租约。

collocations: a clause permitting signing in counterparts

words.enDefinition: an arrangement that creates enforceable obligations for the parties

examples.en: I asked the adviser when the signed lease would become a binding agreement for everyone.
examples.zh: 我问顾问，签好的租约什么时候会成为对每个人都有「约束力的协议」。

examples.en: We read the draft before deciding whether to enter a binding agreement with the house owner.
examples.zh: 我们先看了草案，再决定是否和屋主签一份「有约束力的协议」。

words.enDefinition: to include outside material through an explicit reference

examples.en: The agent explained that the lease can incorporate by reference the building's separate bicycle storage rules.
examples.zh: 中介解释，租约可以「通过引用纳入」大楼单独制定的自行车停放规则。

examples.en: I checked which documents the landlord wanted to incorporate by reference before agreeing to sign.
examples.zh: 我先弄清房东想「通过引用纳入」哪些文件，再同意签合同。

collocations: incorporate by reference into the lease

words.enDefinition: an attachment listing detailed information that supplements a lease

examples.en: The lease schedule lists the items the landlord agreed to leave in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 「租约附表」列出了房东同意留在厨房里的物品。

examples.en: I checked the lease schedule to see which storage locker came with the apartment.
examples.zh: 我看了看「租约附表」，想知道公寓配的是哪一个储物柜。

collocations: list an item in the lease schedule

words.enDefinition: the replacement of the person responsible as landlord

examples.en: The letter about a change of landlord listed the person to contact for future repairs.
examples.zh: 关于「出租人变更」的信写明了今后负责报修的联系人。

examples.en: Our adviser explained what to check in the lease after a change of landlord.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「出租人变更」后要查看租约的哪些内容。

collocations: notify tenants of a change of landlord
a notice of change of landlord

words.enDefinition: to make another person a party to the tenancy

examples.en: We asked to add a tenant after a classmate offered to share the second bedroom.
examples.zh: 有位同学提出合租第二间卧室后，我们申请「增加一名租客」。

examples.en: The agent explained which pages we'd need to update if we wanted to add a tenant.
examples.zh: 中介解释了我们想「增加一名租客」的话，需要更新哪几页。

collocations: add a tenant to the lease

words.enDefinition: to read small or easily overlooked contractual details carefully

examples.en: I reminded my flatmates to read the fine print before accepting the landlord's renewal offer.
examples.zh: 我提醒合租室友，接受房东的续租提议前要「细读合同小字条款」。

examples.en: My friend helped me read the fine print about who could use the bike storage area.
examples.zh: 朋友帮我「细读了合同的小字条款」，弄清谁可以使用自行车存放处。

collocations: read the fine print before signing

words.enDefinition: permission to occupy property without granting a tenancy

examples.en: The adviser explained the licence to occupy that the hall office had asked me to sign.
examples.zh: 宿舍办公室让我签一份「居住使用许可」，顾问给我解释了它的意思。

examples.en: I compared the licence to occupy with the document my previous landlord called a lease.
examples.zh: 我把「居住使用许可」和上一位房东称作租约的那份文件做了比较。

words.enDefinition: a contract for renting space in the owner's home

examples.en: I read the lodger agreement before moving into a furnished room in the owner's home.
examples.zh: 搬进屋主家里一间带家具的房间前，我看了「寄宿租住协议」。

examples.en: The lodger agreement says when I can use the kitchen while the owner is at home.
examples.zh: 「寄宿租住协议」写明了屋主在家时，我在什么时间能用厨房。
